items.detail: Managed Chromium blocked direct top-level localhost navigation with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR. Browser proof loaded the exact built application into an isolated about:blank document with loopback-built resources/import map; persistence fetches still traversed the real browser to 127.0.0.1 Local Runtime and SQLite. --disable-web-security was used only in the proof harness.
Node 22.16.0 emits the node:sqlite ExperimentalWarning. This convergence is bound to exact Node 22.16.0; a Node runtime change requires re-proof.

@xterm/xterm was not vendored after official acquisition failed. OperationalTerminalHost uses a truthful DOM renderer fallback. Renderer does not own semantic commands, canonical state, or process lifecycle.
No PTY, PowerShell, SSH, process execution, Docker, VM, or WSL provider is exposed. InternalSimulationAdapter remains the bounded Runtime provider.
No HWND/native-window/OS always-on-top production claim is made.
Active Windows keyboard-layout source remains platform-gated; no fabricated native source.
PS05 closes the bounded Windows target remainder for selected gates but does not promote a successor, freeze the stack, or authorize native desktop capabilities.
This packet grants no Controller acceptance, successor promotion, Surface launch, or stack freeze.
